lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in a quasi-grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, following the longitudinal axis of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands of higher luminance intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadow casting on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots scattered across the medial surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration near the base.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of micro-spots on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits; presence of multiple small secondary silhouettes along the ventral margin.
